changes.description: Complete Electron desktop application for local task and secret management
Password-based encryption using AES-256 with PBKDF2 key derivation for secure data storage
Task management system with status tracking (Todo, In Progress, Completed) and priority levels
Secret manager for secure storage of sensitive information like passwords and API keys
Interactive dashboard with real-time statistics and overview of tasks and secrets
Live clock with date display showing current time with seconds precision
Dark and light theme support with system preference detection
Comprehensive settings panel for user personalization (name, username, app title)
Dynamic application title that changes based on username settings
Changelog system with version tracking and 'What's New' notifications
First-time setup wizard for password creation and initial configuration
Windows executable (.exe) build with portable installation support
Local JSON-based encrypted database for offline data storage
Modern responsive UI built with React, TypeScript, and TailwindCSS
Keyboard shortcuts and accessibility features for improved user experience
Automatic data persistence and secure local storage management
